decisions.scenario: Finding a Monday train from Kings Lynn to Cambridge arriving by 14:45

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need a train from Kings Lynn to Cambridge on Monday that arrives by 14:45.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: One suitable option leaves Kings Lynn at 13:11.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That departure time works for me. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You’re welcome. Have a good trip.

decisions.notes: Retained because the Monday 13:11 Kings-Lynn-to-Cambridge departure adds route/day/time coverage not present in the reviewed corpus. The source turn that incorrectly repeats the departure time when asked for the arrival time is omitted.
